rows.jyutping: daai3 zyu6 ji4 man6 jyu5 hei3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for speaking or acting in a questioning manner.

example.english: They asked me interrogatively why I came back so late.
example.traditional: 佢帶住疑問語氣問我點解咁夜先返嚟。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daai3 zyu6 ji4 man6 jyu5 hei3 man6 ngo5 dim2 gaai2 gam3 je6 sin1 faan1 lai4

rows.jyutping: jung6 ji4 man6 geoi3 lai4 V
rows.note: Use this when the point is that V is done by forming or using an actual question.

example.english: We use a question interrogatively to clarify the matter instead of guessing.
example.traditional: 我哋用疑問句嚟問清楚件事，唔好靠估。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 ji4 man6 geoi3 lai4 man6 cing1 co2 gin6 si6 m4 hou2 kaau3 gu2
